evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We built gpu-train-debug, a deterministic benchmark of 1,877 synthetic GPU and LLM training failure diagnosis tasks across 30 archetypes, graded by a programmatic verifier with partial credit, and calibrated so that a mid-tier model scores in a 0.60 to 0.75 band.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: At the pre-registered scale (60 GRPO steps, learning rate 1e-6), the answer is: no detectable improvement in-distribution (+0.22 points, 95% CI [-0.06, +0.51]), and a modest but measurable improvement under distribution shift (+0.33 points on a held-out OOD split, CI [+0.02, +0.68]).

evidence.excerpt: We measure that contribution directly, in a controlled setting where both stages can be run to completion and compared exactly.
